description: The always-on built-in tools and services every agent has from the first turn — time, date, math, attachments, session search, the context tools (compact_context to deliberately fold older turns, recall_compacted to read the verbatim turns behind a summary, search_this_session to find a detail across the whole chat — the automatic compaction that backs them runs as an App Function), user/webhook registration, the self-improvement tools (an agent reading/improving its OWN prompt and teaching itself reusable skills), and the discovery tools that load everything else. These are wired into the agent directly and are NOT part of any ability, so they are listed here for reference and permission management. Every listed tool honors the normal Deny/Ask/Auto permission; an explicit Deny removes it from the model catalog and callable schemas. Long-term memory is configured separately under Knowledge. read_own_prompt/edit_own_prompt act only on the agent's OWN unlocked prompt sections (lock a section to protect it from self-editing); save_own_skill/remove_own_skill let the agent write its OWN reusable how-to skills, guided by the bundled self-improvement skill. It also carries the chat-presentation pair the mode machinery depends on: present_plan (the durable Plan Overview + Task Progress checklist that Plan mode requires - a mode contract must never depend on an optional ability an admin can switch off) and present_chat_component (in-chat status/choice/approval/form cards).
note: Always on — built-in core tools, shown here for reference.
skill_summary: Read this BEFORE improving yourself: the rules for when to save a reusable skill (save_own_skill) vs a fact in memory vs a durable change to your own prompt (edit_own_prompt) — e.g. when you build something reusable, work out a non-obvious procedure, or get a specific lasting instruction from the user.
